NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) has experienced a highly volatile and transformative period over the trailing thirty days leading up to November 15, 2026. Most notably, the company announced a major leadership transition on November 12, 2026, revealing that longtime President, Chief Executive Officer, and board member Jensen Huang has resigned ([Home | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com)). This leadership change closely followed an announcement by the NVIDIA Board of Directors on November 8, 2026, initiating an independent investigation—overseen by a committee of independent directors and outside counsel—in response to reports that Jensen Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort ([Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)). Although the board stated it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised, and emphasized that Jensen fully supports the review, the leadership shift marks a monumental turning point for the computer hardware manufacturing giant ([Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)).

In addition to executive changes, NVIDIA has continued to execute aggressive strategic partnerships and technological expansions across global markets. On November 8, 2026, NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a collaborative initiative to advance Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure utilizing NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ to integrate NVIDIA's open infrastructure platform with Korean-designed AI processors ([Latest News | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/latest)). Furthermore, NVIDIA has expanded its open-source and next-generation network footprint, highlighting tools that assist researchers in building next-generation 6G networks using its Aerial wireless software and Sionna ([Latest News | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/latest)). 

From an inorganic growth and capital allocation perspective, NVIDIA maintains a robust historical acquisition strategy, having completed 35 acquisitions spanning 32 sectors across 9 countries with an average acquisition amount of $9.67 billion ([List of 35 Acquisitions by Nvidia (Nov 2026) - Tracxn](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)). Its peak acquisition years include 7 in 2024, 6 in 2025, and 4 completed in calendar year 2026, highlighted by the blockbuster acquisition of the open-source machine learning platform Hugging Face in September 2026 for a sticker price of $12.93 billion ([List of 35 Acquisitions by Nvidia (Nov 2026) - Tracxn](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4), [August 2026 M&A: NVIDIA, Fortinet Lead AI Deal Wave](https://www.channelinsider.com/channel-business/mergers-and-acquisitions/august-2026-ma-recap)).

## Talking Points

* **Leadership Transition and Governance Stability:** The sudden resignation of Jensen Huang following the board's independent review introduces execution risk. Stakeholders must evaluate how the incoming leadership team plans to preserve NVIDIA’s technological vision and market dominance in GPU and AI platforms ([Home | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com), [Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)).
* **Sovereign AI and International Collaborations:** Highlight NVIDIA's strategic moves in Asia, particularly the November 2026 collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions leveraging NVLink Fusion to build sovereign AI infrastructure in Korea ([Latest News | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/latest)). This illustrates NVIDIA’s capability to embed its hardware into localized state and enterprise frameworks.
* **Integration of Recent Acquisitions:** Assess the ongoing integration and market rollout of Hugging Face (acquired for $12.93 billion in September 2026) and its early derivative deployments, such as the Microduck robot launch, showcasing how open-source repositories augment NVIDIA's physical AI pipelines ([List of 35 Acquisitions by Nvidia (Nov 2026) - Tracxn](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4), [August 2026 M&A: NVIDIA, Fortinet Lead AI Deal Wave](https://www.channelinsider.com/channel-business/mergers-and-acquisitions/august-2026-ma-recap), [List of 35 Acquisitions by Nvidia (Nov 2026) - Tracxn](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).
* **Financial Health & Operational Scale:** With an annual revenue base standing at $215.94 billion and massive global web traffic (over 40 million monthly visits), NVIDIA possesses the balance sheet strength to absorb multibillion-dollar transactions and fund next-generation R&D like 6G network tools and Vera CPU-GPU hybrid architectures ([NVIDIA](https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t), [Latest News | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/latest)).
